systems.owner: Government of Seychelles (health sector capital budget)

note: No fact: the address names the health information system without saying what it does, so it is unclassified. What it states, for the parent to attach once the class is settled elsewhere: the 2023 budget (delivered 2022-11-04) allocates R 27.13 million to 'the continuation of the Health Information System project' within R 118.8 million of health-sector capital projects, with no external financier named for it (the La Digue hospital line beside it is marked as a UAE grant), which would be governance finance:domestic for FY2023; and the minister expects the system 'will come into operation towards the end of 2022'.
